nodes.label: BotApplication
nodes.rationale: Central class in bot.py that initializes Telegram Application, registers all handlers, configures scheduler, handles errors, and performs graceful shutdown. Acts as composition root for the bot.

nodes.label: ConversationHandler (multi-step flow)
nodes.rationale: Used for all multi-step commands (/add, /addplan, /summary, /edit). Provides state machine for user interaction. Pattern: define states as int constants, entry_points, states dict, fallbacks with /cancel.

nodes.label: API Client (utils/api_client.py)
nodes.rationale: Async httpx client with JWT auth via cookies, retry logic with exponential backoff, centralized error handling. All backend communication routed through this component.

nodes.label: Telegram OAuth HMAC-SHA256 (utils/telegram_auth.py)
nodes.rationale: Validates Telegram OAuth data using HMAC-SHA256 per official Telegram docs. JWT tokens issued with 7-day lifetime, stored as HTTP-only cookies on backend for security.

nodes.label: APScheduler (utils/scheduler.py)
nodes.rationale: Runs background jobs (weekly reports via CronTrigger Sunday 20:00 UTC). Timezone-aware scheduling using UTC to avoid drift.

nodes.label: Notification Service (utils/notification_service.py)
nodes.rationale: Checks budget overrun in real time on each transaction creation. Uses deduplication to avoid repeat alerts. Default threshold 90%, configurable per user.

nodes.label: CFO/MVZ Integration (Financial & Cost Centers)
nodes.rationale: ЦФО (financial centers) and МВЗ (cost centers) are optional fields on transactions, selected via inline keyboard. Both support SCD Type 2 for historical tracking. Backward compatible — existing records without these fields are unaffected.

nodes.label: JWT Token Authentication
nodes.rationale: 7-day JWT tokens stored in context.user_data for bot session persistence. HTTP-only cookies on backend. Refresh token mechanism planned (TASK-020).

nodes.label: Webhook Mode (vs Polling)
nodes.rationale: Webhook recommended for production; polling used for development. Webhook requires SSL (Let's Encrypt) and nginx reverse proxy. Controlled by USE_WEBHOOK env var.

nodes.label: Mock API Client Fixture
nodes.rationale: Tests use mocked API client to avoid real backend calls, enabling fast isolated tests. Mocked methods: authenticate_telegram_user, get_articles, create_fact, get_facts_summary.
